claim: Let \(M_8\) be the Wagner graph, with vertex set \(\mathbb Z/8\mathbb Z\), cycle edges \(\{i,i+1\}\), and antipodal edges \(\{i,i+4\}\). Let \(\operatorname{Match}(M_8)\) be the ordinary matching complex whose faces are matchings of \(M_8\). Then \[\operatorname{Match}(M_8)\simeq \bigvee^{6}S^2.\]

correctness.rationale: Complete enumeration gives 105 nonempty faces with face vector \((12,42,44,7)\). A 49-pair matching on the complete face poset is verified acyclic across all 244 Hasse covers and leaves one critical \(0\)-cell plus six critical \(2\)-cells. Forman reduction therefore gives a wedge of six \(2\)-spheres. Independent mod-2 boundary ranks \((11,31,7)\) give reduced Betti vector \((0,0,6,0)\).

value.rationale: \(M_8\) is the canonical eight-vertex Möbius ladder, a standard symmetric cubic graph. Its ordinary matching complex is a natural topology invariant distinct from the independence and perfect-matching complexes recently studied on the same family. The exact homotopy type and complete finite Morse certificate provide a useful base case for a natural family rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
